detail.longDescription: I asked rela (the assistant inside my open source crm relaticle) once for a task and a note (in a test workspace). It shows me a plan, one line per change, one approve button. There was no task or note until I clicked approve. Relaticle (my open source CRM) has an MCP server for AI agents right in the core app. Claude and ChatGPT connect to it, and over the MCP protocol, they don't need a plan, they don't need an approve button, the writes just land right away. Not sure yet if those writes should wait for approval too. I started writing this in August 2024. It's written in Laravel + PostgreSQL. I'm releasing it under the AGPL-3.0 license. If you want to try it out you can run it using the compose file in the README. I'm very interested in hearing from people who let an agent write to a real system and what they have to say about it.
